content:
Students can check their SBBWU results online at: https://sbbwu.edu.pk/sbbwu/Result

Open the link and go to the Online Result section. If your result has been announced, enter your Roll Number, select the relevant examination from the dropdown, and click Submit.

Available options include:
- MA/M.Sc/BS
- BA/B.Sc Annual
- BA/B.Sc (Supplementary)

If your result is not displayed, it may not have been announced or uploaded by the university yet.
